rv-simulator: For e=0, K=(2πG/P)^(1/3) Mp sin i/(M★+Mp)^(2/3), v★=K sin(2π phase). Positive v is receding. Masses use the documented IAU nominal-GM/G conversion. Without inclination, RV constrains a mass function; Mp sin i is the usual small-Mp/M★ minimum-mass approximation. We retain Mp in the denominator. Doppler-shift readout is relativistic; the curve is nonrelativistic two-body motion. The linked spectral line width is illustrative and magnified for teaching, not an instrument line-spread function. No eccentricity, activity, blends or additional planets.
